tools.name: prune
tools.description: Prune comments and empty lines from a text payload to reduce token count. Use this for shrinking context window size. Do NOT use for format conversion or diffing.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert a text payload between JSON, YAML, TOML, and CSV formats. Use this for config/data format interchange. Do NOT use for pruning comments or generating llms.txt.

tools.name: estimate
tools.description: Estimate the USD cost of an LLM API call given model name and token counts. Use this for budgeting/cost projection. Do NOT use for actual text generation.

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Generate a unified diff between two text payloads. Use this to show changes between two versions of text. Do NOT use for applying patches.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: Apply a unified diff patch to text. Use this to transform text using a previously-generated diff. Do NOT use for generating new diffs.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt agent-discovery file from structured service metadata. Use this to produce llms.txt for a new API. Do NOT use for validating existing llms.txt.

tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate an llms.txt payload for spec compliance. Use this to check an existing llms.txt before publishing. Do NOT use for generating new llms.txt.
